title: DSPy ile Atıf Niyeti Sınıflandırma ve Optimizasyon Projesi
summary: A DSPy-based project for classifying citation intent in academic texts using LLMs (OpenAI GPT, Google Gemini) with MIPROv2 prompt optimization. The only SDV-family match is an incidental substring in a local build-cache file path inside requirements.txt, not an actual dependency on SDV.
